title: NOR2 retained physical issue to exact key-cell join
method: Read-only, bounded overlay of the two exact original native cells against retained per-target physical support and issue geometries. This is not a producer rerun, broad scan, physical clearance, or qualification result.

original_contract.relevant_clause: Clause 5 keeps source, physical, and native evidence distinct and requires each original cell to be supported, held, already owned, or explicitly unresolved; target-level issues are retained rather than automatically assigned to every key.

overlay.runtime: Previously approved isolated Python 3.12.14 environment with Shapely 2.1.2; only these two cell geometries and the receipt's issue/support geometries were evaluated.
overlay.cell_bounds_coordinate_units: longitude/latitude degrees from the retained native-grid cell formula; reported distances are planar degree distances and are not geodesic measurements.
overlay.predicate: For each exact native-cell rectangle, test center coverage by mapped land/water, intersection and full coverage by mapped land, and intersection with each issue geometry.

interpretation: The two whole-target issue geometries do not intersect either exact cell. Mapped-land support intersects each cell and covers its center, but does not cover the whole cell. The whole-target issue records remain preserved, and both original cells remain native-held. The outside-NOR key's official 2022 Fylke comparison remains a source-applicability question; being outside Norway does not establish Russian jurisdiction. The actual stock native diagnostic accepted the outside key as assigned_cells and retained the inside key as territorial_exclusion_cells (first failure unique-source-target-coverage). This is screening only; no authority, constructor, or root acceptance is implied.
